input.summary: Narrow TrueLink's Credit Data licence to service delivery and add a perpetual licence to Support Services work product
input.comment: [Playbook] We narrowed TrueLink's licence in our Credit Data so it may only process that data to deliver the services to us, rather than distribute, resell or exploit it, and we added a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the work product it creates for us. TrueLink keeps ownership of the Interface.

ops.oldText: use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to
ops.newText: use, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data solely to provide the Hosting Services and Support Services to Client, subject to

ops.text: Work Product. TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense all results of the Support Services and any other work product prepared for Client under this Agreement for Client's business purposes.
